comment: Cyclizes the precursor peptide WgkA, forming two C–C bonds between Trp18 and Lys20. This is the first tailoring step in tryglysin A biosynthesis.

reactions.description: Forms two C–C bonds in the precursor peptide WgkA: Trp18-C5 to Lys20-Cα and Trp18-C6 to Lys20-Cδ. The stereochemistry at Lys Cα and Cδ in the product is not known.
